messages:
sara (sec-eng): quick sync — i'm triaging audit logging coverage gaps across api-gateway / auth / console / billing / runtime. can owners confirm current gaps and blockers?

 tom (eng-sre): got it. can you paste the specific missing events you saw?

 sara (sec-eng): pasted from backlog snapshot:
 - api-gateway: missing 'route.update' and partial 'client.cert.rotate' events for delegated auth paths
 - auth: admin role rename events not emitted after sso migration; some 2fa disable events only in metrics not audit stream
 - console: settings-change events sometimes lack user_id when triggered via service token (our `actor` field null)
 - billing: invoice adjustments and manual credits not consistently logged to audit service (customers flagged)
 - runtime: ephemeral job starts/stops show only pid but no image_digest or model_version

 julen (eng-platform): thanks. quick note — runtime gap likely from the worker-side log shim not shipping the new schema field `model_version`. we'll need a shim rev + deploy.

 kevin (auth): on the auth side the RBAC rename we did (role:admin -> role:super_admin) changed how the code populates `actor.role` in events. i can add a compatibility mapper in the event builder to preserve historical names for audit consumers.

 marie (billing): customer reported missing invoice adjustment events for MRT-12 tenant. i've got a support ticket (SUP-2083) with examples. looks like adjustments that originate from our billing-import job skip the audit wrapper.

 sara (sec-eng): ok owners: api-gateway -> tom, auth -> kevin, console -> julen for service tokens, billing -> marie, runtime -> julen. please confirm ETA for fixes and whether schema changes are required.

 tom (eng-sre): api-gateway — short-term: emit route.update from edge-proxy v2 (PR ready, needs canary). ETA: 2 days. schema: no change, just add event type.

 kevin (auth): auth — i'll add the role-compat mapper today and include a migration flag. ETA: 1 day. schema: patch only. also question: do we need to version the event schema for role semantics?

 sara (sec-eng): prefer not to bump major schema if we can avoid it. add `role_aliases` mapping in processor for now and document in schema v1.2 notes. we'll consider major versioning if consumers need strict typing.

 julen (eng-platform): console/runtime — runtime needs shim update + new env var to include `MODEL_DIGEST` in audit payloads. console needs to populate `actor.user_id` when service-token origin by reading `x-service-owner` header (we added that header in gateway). ETA: runtime shim 3 days, console patch 2 days. schema: add optional `model_version` field (non-breaking).

 marie (billing): billing — i'll instrument billing-import job to call audit-client around the credit adjustments. small PR in billing-worker. ETA: 2 days. will attach SUP-2083 examples to ticket.

 sara (sec-eng): KMS question from backlog: do we want to encrypt PII in audit payloads at rest? current plan: store encrypted payloads using customer KMS when tenant opts in. julen?

 julen (eng-platform): yes we should. implementation idea: audit-ingest service accepts optional `encryption_key_id` header; if present it will call KMS to wrap the per-record DEK and store metadata. need to check KMS kps throughput for high-volume tenants.

 kevin (auth): also check RBAC on key use — only admin+compliance roles should be able to request decryption. tie into KMS IAM. we should add audit events for `kms.key.create` / `kms.key.use` / `kms.key.rotate`.

 sara (sec-eng): good call — add those events to backlog. make sure customer-facing validation tests cover: 1) tenant opt-in encryption end-to-end, 2) decryption with correct role, 3) audit entries for key lifecycle.

 audit-bot: reminder: create or link tickets for each owner. template: "svc: short desc — owner — PR/branch — canary plan — ETA"

 tom (eng-sre): created GH-4211 for api-gateway events, branch: fix/route-update, canary tomorrow.

 kevin (auth): GH-4220 created for role-compat mapper. i'll include unit tests asserting old event names map to `super_admin` in processor.

 julen (eng-platform): GH-4223 for runtime shim and GH-4224 for console token actor fix. added integration test to assert `actor.user_id` present when `x-service-owner` header set.

 marie (billing): GH-4228 for billing-import audit wrapper. attached SUP-2083 examples.

 sara (sec-eng): excellent. follow-ups:
 - can each owner add a short test-case that a customer could run to validate the fix? (we'll use for customer-facing validation)
 - add a line in the schema docs for any optional fields (model_version, encryption_key_id) and mark compatibility notes
 - schedule handoff to compliance for evidence collection after canaries pass

 kevin (auth): on tests — i'll add an end-to-end that ingests SSO admin rename action and verifies audit record contains both `actor.role` alias and `actor.role_normalized`.

 tom (eng-sre): will add a simple curl example to GH-4211 for canary hits.

 julen (eng-platform): adding integration job to nightly CI to surface regressions in `actor` fields and `model_version` emission.

 marie (billing): will prepare customer validation checklist for SUP-2083 and offer to run with them once PR is live.

 sara (sec-eng): cool. i'll roll this into the audit-backlog board and mark blockers if any external infra is required. next sync in 48h — please update GH tickets and ping here if you hit infra/KMS/perf limits. :white_check_mark:
